content: Mlɩdamli Ɩklʋntɔ, Mɛ́nɩ Mlɩmóowu
Ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ ɩnʋ alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ akʋ bɛbláa Yesu bɛɛ, Pilato lamɔ́ Galileafɔ akʋ brɛ́á bʋdɛ afɔdɩɛ bɔ há Bulu, Yerusalem Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa ɩnʋ, há obugya lada afɔdɩɛ ámʋ.
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩkɩ́ mlɩaa, Galileafɔ ánfɩ bʋgyi lakpan abwɛpʋ́ dʋn Galileafɔ atráhɛ, sʋ́ bowun ɩwɩɔsɩn ánfɩ odu?
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, megyí alɩ ígyi! Nɩ́ mlɩ ɛ́ mlɩmɛ́damlí klʋntɔ á, mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ mlówu fɛ́ amʋ́.
Ntɛ́ɛ ahá dúkwe ámʋ́ʋ́ abansʋ́rʋ lobwie dá mɔ́ Siloam ɔmanti ánɩ́ ɩbʋ Yerusalemtɔ ámʋ mɛ́, mlɩkɩ́ mlɩaa, lakpan abwɛpʋ́ bʋgyi dʋn aha atráhɛ ánɩ́ betsiá Yerusalem alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ fɛ́ɛ́?
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, megyí alɩ ígyi. Nɩ́ mlɩmɛ́damlí klʋntɔ á, mlɩ ɛ́ mlówu fɛ́ amʋ́.”
Pɔntɔ Máswíéhɛ́
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛha amʋ́ yébi ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Oyin ɔkʋ lótswíe pɔntɔ mʋ ndɔtɔ. Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ ɔlɔyɔ yɛ́kɩ bɛɛ, abí kʋ ɩdɩn mʋ́tɔ́. Ɔlɔyɔ á, kʋkʋ mɛdɩ́n mʋ́tɔ́.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔlɛbláa mʋ ɔpayin ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Nfinsa nɩ́, nna oyí ánfɩ asɩ. Mmɔkʋ́wun kʋkʋʋkʋ mʋ́tɔ́. Ntogyi sʋ́ ɩbɛ́trá lɩɩ́ yíntá ɔsʋlʋ́ʋ? Kun mʋ́ da!’
Támɛ ɔpayin amʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mɩ́ wíé, fʋ́ mʋ́ si mʋ́ ɩtra lɩɩ ofi ɔkʋlɛ, ampulipuli mʋ́ asɩ, kpa wúna wa mʋ́ asɩ.
Nɩ́ ofíébá iloswie á, ɩbʋ alɛ́, támɛ nɩ́ imoswie á, nakun mʋ́ dá.’ ”
Ɔtsɩ Ɔkʋ Ɩlɔ Tsa Ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ Ɔdakɛ́
Yesu lɔ́yɔ ɔdɛ atɔ́ suná Yudafɔ ofíakpa ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́ ɩkʋ.
Ɔtsɩ ɔkʋá ɔŋɛ laláhɛ lɔ́wa mʋ ɩlɔ nfí dúkwe nɩ́, ɩlahá mʋ alaklo, ɔmɛtálɩ́ bwíí nátɩ́ bʋ ɩnʋ.
Brɛ́á Yesu lówun mʋ á, ɔlɛtɩ mʋ bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Anɩ yín, ɩwɩ ɩwá fʋ́ ɔnlɩn!”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɔpʋ ɩbɩ da ɔtsɩ ámʋ. Ɩnʋnʋ olotswií lɩ́ɩ́ kánfʋ́ Bulu.
Ofíakpa ɔhandɛ amʋ lénya ɔblɔ́ ánɩ́ Yesu latsá ɔha ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛbláa ahá ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nkensíé bʋ ɩnʋ há agyʋ́má yɔ. Mlɩba nkɛ ámʋtɔ, abʋtsa mlɩ ɩlɔ. Megyí ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́!”
Anɩ Wíe Yesu lɛ́lɛ mɔ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Apinabwɛbí abwɛpʋ́! Mlɩtɔ okugyíɔkʋ tɔwɔ́ɩ́ mʋ nnantswie ntɛ́ɛ afrímú lɛ́ ɩbantɔ, pʋ́ amʋ́ ya ntsu onúkpa ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́.
Mʋ́ ɩma alɛá mɩ́ mʋ́ nɛ́sankɩ́ Abraham mʋ na ánfɩ Ɔbʋnsám lakɩ́klɩ mʋ nfí dúkwe kɛ́kɛ́ ánfɩ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́?”
Mʋ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ anfɩ lɛ́ha pɛ́lɩ lɛ́kɩtá mʋ alupʋ́ ámʋ, ansɩ́ légyi atráhɛ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́, ofúla kpɔnkpɔntɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔdɛbwɛ ámʋ sʋ.
Takyí-akpin Ibí Yébi
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntɔ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ lɛlɩan? Ntɛ́ɛ ntɔ nɔ́pʋkápʋ́ mʋ?
Igyi fɛ́ takyí-akpin ibí, oyin ɔkʋ lódu wá mʋ ndɔtɔ. Ɩlɛdan mlí oyi yilé, mbubwi bʋtogyónká mʋ́ abámbitɔ.”
Bodobodotu-afá Yébi
Yesu lɛ́trá blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntɔ mpʋ́kapʋ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ?
Igyi fɛ́ Bodobodotu-afá ánɩ́ ɔtsɩ ɔkʋ lɔ́pʋtsɩ́á bodobodo nfúó kɛntɛ kʋlɛ, ɩlɛha mʋ́ ilotu.”
Obu-ɔnɔ́ Kplánhɛ
Brɛ́á Yesu ɔyɔ́ Yerusalem a, ɔlɔtsʋn nkudasɩ pʋ́ awúlusʋ. Ɔna ɔdɛ amʋ́ atɔ́ suná.
Ɔha ɔkʋ lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Owíé, ahá kpalobí kʋ obénya nkpa?” Yesu lɛ́bláa ahá ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Mlɩbɔ mbɔ́dɩ́ amlɩtsʋn obu-ɔnɔ́ kplánhɛ amʋtɔ. Tsúfɛ́ ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bɔ́bɔ mbɔ́dɩ́ ánɩ́ bɔ́tsʋn wie ɩnʋ, támɛ bʋmɛ́ɛtalɩ́.
Támɛ nɩ́ wóyí mʋ wie ɔkʋ́sʋ́ fin obu ámʋ, mlɛbá bɛlɩɩ́ klʋn ɔma, dá klʋn amʋsʋ mlɩaa, ‘Owíé, finki ha anɩ!’ á, ɔbɛ́bláa mlɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mmeyín mlɩ, mmeyín ɔtɩ́nɛ́á mlotsú.’
Ɩnʋ́ mlɛ́blɩ́ mlɩaa, ‘Anɩa fʋnyɔ létsiá gyi atɔ́, nú ntá, fetsiá súná atɔ́ anɩ dɩnsʋ!’
Támɛ ɔbɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mmeyín mlɩ. Mmeyín ɔtɩ́nɛ́á mlotsú. Mlɩnatɩ tɛɩ mɩ́sʋ́, mlɩ lalahɛ abwɛpʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́!’
Nɩ́ mlowun Abraham, Isak, Yakob pʋ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋbʋ Bulu iwíe ogyíkpá, támɛ bʋmɛha mlɩ mʋ́ ɔkpa amlɩwie ɩnʋ á, ɩnʋ́ mlósu kpisíi nɩ.
Ahá bótsu owí ɔdalɩkpa pʋ́ owí ɔkplɩ́wíékpá, bɩnasʋ mʋ́a gyɔpɩsʋ ba betsiá atɔ́ ogyíkpá Bulu iwíegyí ámʋtɔ.
Ɔnɔkwalɩ, amapʋ akʋ bémlí agyankpapʋ. Agyankpapʋ akʋ ɛ́ bémlí amapʋ.”
Yesu Lósú Ha Yerusalem
Ɩnʋ Farisifɔ akʋ bɛba Yesu wá bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Dalɩ Galilea ɔmátɔ́ nfɩ, tsúfɛ́ ɔmásʋ́ ogyípʋ́ Herode dékléá ɔbɔ́mɔ fʋ́.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩyɛbláa ɔkpataku ámʋ mlɩaa, ‘Négya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ lɛ́ ahátɔ, tsá ahá ɩlɔ ndɛ, gya lɛ ɔkɛ, mɔ́ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ kláɩ.’
Támɛ ilehián ánɩ́ nɔ́yɔ mɩ́ ɔnátɩ amʋsʋ ndɛ, ɔkɛ mʋ́a kláɩ. Tsúfɛ́ ɔkpa má ɩnʋá bɔ́mɔ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ ɔkʋkʋ ɔtɩnɛtɩnɛ, dʋn Yerusalem!

“Óo Yerusalemfɔ, Yerusalemfɔ! Mlɩtɔ́mɔ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́, dá abí ánɩ́ Bulu lawá sɩ́sɩ́ mlɩ abwi mɔ́ nɩ́. Ntekleá nóbun mlɩ abísʋ́ brégyíbrɛ́, fɛ́ alɩá batɛ tobun mʋ abísʋ́, támɛ mlɩtamahá mɩ́ ɔkpa.
Mlɩkɩ, Bulu obési mlɩ ɔtswɛ́kpa tswɩ mlɩ. Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, mlɩmɛ́ɛtrá wun mɩ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ, yɔ́fʋn ɛkɛá mlɛ́blɩ́ mlɩaa, ‘Bulu oyúla ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔbá mʋ dátɔ́’ ámʋ.”
